_comment: Frozen final model configuration, selected in revision_v3/reports/FINAL_MODEL_SELECTION.md (Phase 2, Part 4). Do not modify without re-running FINAL_MODEL_SELECTION.md's analysis.

architecture.note_on_1_param_gap: 1-parameter total-vs-active gap is float32 gradient-underflow noise on a single dummy batch, not structural -- see PARAMETER_ACCOUNTING_REPORT.md Sec 3.

preprocessing.chunking: 256-token chunks, evenly-spaced selection if over max_chunks=64 (16,384-token budget)
preprocessing.feature_parity_with_v2: verified 100% token-sequence / opcode-count equality, 0.0 max-abs feature diff on 200 sampled contracts (revision_v3/results/feature_parity_report.json)

training_protocol.folds: 5 stored family-disjoint outer folds; test=fold f, val=fold (f+1)%5, train=remaining 3
training_protocol.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss(pos_weight = n_neg/n_pos on the train fold)
training_protocol.calibration: single-scalar temperature scaling, LBFGS, fit on validation logits only
training_protocol.thresholds: order-statistic thresholds on validation-negative calibrated scores at nominal 1%/5%/10% FPR

determinism.verified_by: revision_v3/tests/test_determinism.py -- two independent runs of the same seed/fold produced bit-for-bit identical (max abs diff 0.0) test predictions

selection_rationale_summary: Selected over authguard_reference_v3 because of a statistically supported (bootstrap CI excludes zero) and practically meaningful (+0.052 AUPRC, ~6% relative) robustness advantage under the final paper-grade Flood-200% protocol, with clean-data performance statistically tied and calibration/stability metrics favorable. Full reasoning: revision_v3/reports/FINAL_MODEL_SELECTION.md.
